issues.quote: 你打電話來的時候我正準備要走。
issues.description: Called is translated as a telephone call. That is a natural reading but the source also permits calling out; the medium is not explicitly established. This keeps the same nonblocking lexical ambiguity treatment as the preceding English controls.

issues.quote: 詢問滯留原由與請求稍候
issues.description: 滯留 can suggest being delayed or unable to leave more strongly than still here establishes. It can also be read broadly as remaining, so this is a precision warning rather than a definite event error. A neutral title such as 詢問停留原因 would better preserve the source scope.
